title: 运行前必须快速检查更新，升级时清理旧版本目录
prompt: 每次运行前快速检查 PMWorkspace 是否有新版本；如果有，先询问用户是否更新。执行更新时删除本地旧版本内容，只保留最新版本。

expected.gate: 快速更新检查与清理安装
required_behaviors: 每个 skill preamble 使用 pmw-update-check --quick
快速检查使用短超时和缓存
发现 UPGRADE_AVAILABLE 时先询问用户是否执行 UPGRADE_COMMAND
auto_upgrade 不为 true 时不能静默升级
pmw-upgrade 安装前删除旧 PMWorkspace 安装目录
升级不删除 ~/.pmworkspace 项目状态和产物资产
forbidden_behaviors: 每次运行都做慢速 git ls-remote 阻塞产品工作
发现更新后不询问用户直接升级
复制新版本时保留旧安装目录里的废弃文件
升级时删除用户项目状态或产品简报资产

contract_checks.contains: --quick  Use a short timeout and fresh cached result when available.
Do not upgrade silently when `auto_upgrade` is not true
deletes the old PMWorkspace-owned install directory before copying new files

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; printf '99.0.0
' > "$tmp/VERSION"; printf 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
' > "$tmp/REVISION"; out=$(PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" PMW_REMOTE_VERSION_URL="file://$tmp/VERSION" PMW_REMOTE_REVISION_URL="file://$tmp/REVISION" PMW_REPO_URL="https://invalid.local/PMWorkspace.git" bin/pmw-update-check --quick --force); printf '%s
' "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_AVAILABLE ' <<< "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_COMMAND pmw-upgrade --host ' <<< "$out"

tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$tmp/state"; printf 'UPGRADE_AVAILABLE 0.1.0 99.0.0@aaaaaaa codex
UPGRADE_COMMAND pmw-upgrade --host codex
' > "$tmp/state/last-update-check"; out=$(PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" PMW_REPO_URL="https://invalid.local/PMWorkspace.git" bin/pmw-update-check --quick); printf '%s
' "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_AVAILABLE 0.1.0 99.0.0@aaaaaaa codex' <<< "$out"; grep -q '^UPGRADE_COMMAND pmw-upgrade --host codex' <<< "$out"

tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace"; printf stale > "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace/stale.txt"; PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" PMW_REPO_URL="$PWD" CODEX_PLUGINS_DIR="$tmp/plugins" CODEX_MARKETPLACE_PATH="$tmp/marketplace.json" PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" bin/pmw-upgrade --host codex-plugin > "$tmp/out" 2>&1; cat "$tmp/out"; test ! -e "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace/stale.txt"; test -f "$tmp/plugins/plugins/pmworkspace/skills/pmworkspace-shared/VERSION"; grep -q 'PMW_REMOVED_OLD_VERSION codex-plugin' "$tmp/out"

tmp=$(mktemp -d); target=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" "$target"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$tmp/skills" "$target/pm-workspace-target"; printf keep > "$target/pm-workspace-target/keep.txt"; ln -s "$target/pm-workspace-target" "$tmp/skills/pm-workspace"; PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" PMW_REPO_URL="$PWD" CODEX_SKILLS_DIR="$tmp/skills" PMW_HOME="$tmp/state" bin/pmw-upgrade --host codex > "$tmp/out" 2>&1; cat "$tmp/out"; test -f "$target/pm-workspace-target/keep.txt"; test -d "$tmp/skills/pm-workspace"; test ! -L "$tmp/skills/pm-workspace"; grep -q 'PMW_REMOVED_OLD_VERSION codex-skill' "$tmp/out"
